description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hikkaduwa, Hikkaduwa D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810105
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and other land-specific details. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
